safetyNotices: Rabbitfish dorsal, pelvic, and anal fin spines can cause a painful venomous puncture.
A physical specimen may only be handled or dissected under trained supervision using an institution-approved safety protocol.
This virtual activity demonstrates orientation and sequence; it does not authorize unsupervised physical dissection.
